messages.author: Kwame Asante
messages.text: Post-mortem for the Google Android attribution outage (Aug 6-9) is on Confluence. Main action items: (1) post-rotation health check for every network link, (2) alert on paid click->install CVR drop + same-platform organic spike, (3) dashboards annotate Aug 6-9, (4) Google Android excluded from CPI/ROAS trend reads for those dates. Review meeting Monday.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Read it, looks good. One addition: note that Attributa can't restate, so the Organic Android numbers for those days stay inflated forever.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Reviewed in the meeting. All four actions approved, owners as listed. Alert (2) is live as of today.
